notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier, survey and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 3 continuous 40-ft bays, W14X109 girders, one 5-ton pendant crane, on new welded twin-rib bracket seats welded to the existing W14X90 columns, with the rail, ties, bearings and end stops; the existing columns are checked with their existing load effects and the existing sidewall rod bracing takes the crane longitudinal forces. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier.

selections.reason: Lightest compact W within the sizing targets (ratio ≤ 0.85, deflections ≤ 0.9 of the limits): top-flange tip stress (DG7, warping and second-order twist) ratio 0.74, vertical deflection 0.89 and lateral 0.13 of their limits; flanges at least 8.5 in wide for the end bearing bolt gauge and the rail seat; lighter candidates rejected: 32 by sizing ratio, 42 by flange width; the next lighter, W30X108: tips ratio 23687.67 > 0.85. Configurator sizing ratios; the full calculation checks the section.
Fictitious example existing column for a 5-ton crane (W14X90 to 7.5 t, W14X120 to 15 t, W14X159 to 30 t, else W14X211); replace with the surveyed shape.
Set by the tie sizing: the column face moves out from 20 in (to at most 30 in) until the tie passes its imposed-movement and strength checks.

selections.designed: 2 bolted slip-critical splices: SP1 8.75 ft (0.219 L) before grid 2, SP2 8.75 ft (0.219 L) before grid 3
selections.reason: The continuous girder exceeds the 60 ft practical shipping and erection piece: automatic placement 0.20 to 0.25 of the span from an interior support (the inflection region, nearest 0.22 L), every piece within 60 ft. A490 1 in slip-critical bolts (Class B): top flange 8 bolts each side on two inner plates 0.625 in thick, bottom flange 4 on an outer plate 0.625 in and two inner plates 0.625 in, web 8 on two plates 0.5 in; sized for the larger of the estimated factored actions at the joints (raised by 1/0.85) and 50% of the flange strength (governing: Bottom flange splice · bolt shear, 0.86).

fabrication.steel: Girder ASTM A992; plates, bars and stiffeners ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joints tight (gap 1/16 in max.) with the rail supplier's joint bars and bolts (deferred submittal), bolts pretensioned and re-tightened after 30 and 90 days of operation.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
